passages.text: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a thunderous voice, “Come!”
passages.sermon:
The Lamb is Jesus Christ.
The Lamb opened one of the seven seals.
I watched the Lamb open the seal.
There are four living creatures near the throne.
I heard one of these four living creatures speak.
The living creature spoke with a loud, thunderous voice.
The living creature said, “Come!”
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὸ Ἀρνίον μίαν ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ σφραγίδων καὶ ἤκουσα ἑνὸς ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων λέγοντος ὡς φωνῇ βροντῆς Ἔρχου

passages.text: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
passages.sermon:
John saw a white horse.
A rider sat on the white horse.
The rider held a bow.
Someone gave the rider a crown.
The rider went out to win victories.
The rider went out to conquer.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος λευκός καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἔχων τόξον καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ στέφανος καὶ ἐξῆλθεν νικῶν καὶ ἵνα νικήσῃ

passages.text: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
passages.sermon: The Lamb opened the second seal.\r\nI heard the second living creature speak.\r\nThe living creature said, “Come!”
passages.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν δευτέραν ἤκουσα τοῦ δευτέρου ζῴου λέγοντος Ἔρχου

passages.text: Then another horse went forth. It was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. And he was given a great sword.
passages.sermon:
The Lamb opened the second seal.
A second living creature spoke.
The creature said, “Come!”
Another horse appeared.
This horse was bright red.
A rider sat on the red horse.
Someone gave the rider permission to take away peace from the earth.
The rider caused people to kill one another.
Someone gave the rider a great sword.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἄλλος ἵππος πυρρός καὶ τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἐδόθη αὐτῷ λαβεῖν τὴν εἰρήνην ἐκ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἵνα ἀλλήλους σφάξουσιν καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ μάχαιρα μεγάλη

passages.text: And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” Then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
passages.sermon:
The Lamb opened the third seal.
The Lamb is Jesus Christ.
I heard the third living creature speak.
The third living creature said, “Come!”
I looked.
I saw a black horse.
The rider sat on the black horse.
The rider held a pair of scales in his hand.
passages.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν τρίτην ἤκουσα τοῦ τρίτου ζῴου λέγοντος Ἔρχου Καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος μέλας καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἔχων ζυγὸν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: And I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying, “A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.”
passages.sermon:
John saw a vision from God.
He heard a voice.
The voice came from among the four living creatures.
The voice spoke clearly.
The voice said, “A quart of wheat will cost a denarius.”
The voice also said, “Three quarts of barley will cost a denarius.”
The voice commanded, “Do not harm the oil.”
The voice commanded, “Do not harm the wine.”
passages.original: καὶ ἤκουσα ὡς φωνὴν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων λέγουσαν Χοῖνιξ σίτου δηναρίου καὶ τρεῖς χοίνικες κριθῶν δηναρίου καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον καὶ τὸν οἶνον μὴ ἀδικήσῃς

passages.text: And when the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”
passages.sermon: The Lamb opened the fourth seal.\r\nI heard the voice of the fourth living creature.\r\nThe fourth living creature said, “Come!”
passages.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν τετάρτην ἤκουσα φωνὴν τοῦ τετάρτου ζῴου λέγοντος Ἔρχου

passages.text: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
passages.sermon:
John saw a pale green horse.
A rider sat on the horse.
The rider’s name was Death.
Hades followed after Death.
Death and Hades received authority.
They had power over a fourth of the earth.
They could kill with the sword.
They could kill with famine.
They could kill with plague.
They could kill by the wild animals of the earth.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος χλωρός καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ὁ Θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἠκολούθει μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἐξουσία ἐπὶ τὸ τέταρτον τῆς γῆς ἀποκτεῖναι ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν θηρίων τῆς γῆς

passages.text: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
passages.sermon:
The Lamb opened the fifth seal.
I saw something under the altar.
I saw the souls of people there.
These people had been killed.
They died because of the word of God.
They died because they held to their testimony.
passages.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν πέμπτην σφραγῖδα εἶδον ὑποκάτω τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ἐσφαγμένων διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἣν εἶχον

passages.text: And they cried out in a loud voice, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You avenge our blood and judge those who dwell upon the earth?”
passages.sermon:
The souls of those who had been killed for the word of God were under the altar.
They had been killed because they held to the testimony of God.
They cried out with a loud voice.
They said, “O Lord, you are holy and true.
How long until you judge those who live on the earth?
How long until you avenge our blood?”
passages.original: καὶ ἔκραξαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες Ἕως πότε ὁ Δεσπότης ὁ ἅγιος καὶ ἀληθινός οὐ κρίνεις καὶ ἐκδικεῖς τὸ αἷμα ἡμῶν ἐκ τῶν κατοικούντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

passages.text: Then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed, just as they had been killed.
passages.sermon:
Each soul under the altar had been killed for the word of God and for their testimony.
Someone gave each of these souls a white robe.
Someone told them to rest a little longer.
They must wait until the number of their fellow servants is complete.
Their brothers will also be killed, just as they were killed.
They must wait until this happens.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἑκάστῳ στολὴ λευκή καὶ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς ἵνα ἀναπαύσονται ἔτι χρόνον μικρόν ἕως πληρωθῶσιν καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν οἱ μέλλοντες ἀποκτέννεσθαι ὡς καὶ αὐτοί

passages.text: And when I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red, and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree shaken by a great wind.
passages.sermon:
The Lamb opened the sixth seal.
I saw this happen.
A great earthquake shook the earth.
The sun became black.
It looked like sackcloth made from goat hair.
The whole moon turned red.
It looked like blood.
The stars in the sky fell to the earth.
They fell like unripe figs drop from a fig tree.
A strong wind shakes the tree and the figs fall.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν ἕκτην καὶ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο καὶ ὁ ἥλιος ἐγένετο μέλας ὡς σάκκος τρίχινος καὶ ἡ σελήνη ὅλη ἐγένετο ὡς αἷμα καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔπεσαν εἰς τὴν γῆν ὡς συκῆ βάλλει τοὺς ὀλύνθους αὐτῆς ὑπὸ ἀνέμου μεγάλου σειομένη

passages.text: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
passages.sermon:
God showed John a vision.
John saw the sky.
The sky moved away.
The sky moved like a scroll being rolled up.
Every mountain moved from its place.
Every island moved from its place.
passages.original: καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς ἀπεχωρίσθη ὡς βιβλίον ἑλισσόμενον καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ νῆσος ἐκ τῶν τόπων αὐτῶν ἐκινήθησαν

passages.text: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
passages.sermon:
The kings of the earth saw what happened.
The nobles saw it too.
The commanders saw it.
The rich saw it.
The mighty saw it.
Every slave saw it.
Every free person saw it.
All these people hid themselves.
They hid in the caves.
They hid among the rocks of the mountains.
passages.original: Καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ μεγιστᾶνες καὶ οἱ χιλίαρχοι καὶ οἱ πλούσιοι καὶ οἱ ἰσχυροὶ καὶ πᾶς δοῦλος καὶ ἐλεύθερος ἔκρυψαν ἑαυτοὺς εἰς τὰ σπήλαια καὶ εἰς τὰς πέτρας τῶν ὀρέων

passages.text: And they said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.
passages.sermon:
The people spoke to the mountains and the rocks.
They said, “Fall on us.
Hide us.
Hide us from the face of the One who sits on the throne.
Hide us from the wrath of the Lamb.”
passages.original: καὶ λέγουσιν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ ταῖς πέτραις Πέσετε ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς καὶ κρύψατε ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς τοῦ Ἀρνίου

passages.text: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”
passages.sermon:
God sits on the throne.
The Lamb is with Him.
Their anger is great.
The day of Their wrath has come.
No one can stand against it.
No one can endure this day.
passages.original: ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ μεγάλη τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτῶν καὶ τίς δύναται σταθῆναι
